name: Headless Unarmed Walk
prompt: Animate the exact uploaded HEADLESS and EMPTY-HANDED costume walking naturally in place in all eight RPG directions. This is a modular clothing/body layer. Preserve the original open collar/neck stump and leave all space above it transparent. NEVER add a head, face, hair, beard, skull, hat, helmet, filled hood, weapon, staff, bow, sword, shield or held props. Preserve exact costume identity, compact proportions, palette, embroidery, fur, straps, pouches, fabric panels, footwear and existing skin/tattoo details. Keep crisp detailed pixel clusters like the input, do not simplify ornament or redesign. Arms counter-swing the same-side legs with relaxed elbows; alternating left/right planted support, heel contact, toe-off and knee clearance. Modest weight shift and restrained cloth movement. Continuous seamless looping walk: the final phase immediately precedes the first, matching supporting foot, arm phase, neck position/scale, torso height and cloth state, no stop/reset or stationary tail. No camera movement or traveling across frame, no glow, effects, background or cast shadow. Both hands empty in every frame and direction.
